name: Keller’s Customer-Based Brand Equity (CBBE) Pyramid
diagnostic: Have we established sufficient brand salience and performance credibility to support an emotional brand response and active consumer resonance?
artifact: A four-tier equity ladder: Salience, Performance & Imagery, Judgments & Feelings, Resonance.
trap: Buying resonance campaigns before functional performance and category salience are established: hollow recognition, no conversion.
pedigreeFull: Kevin Lane Keller (Journal of Marketing, 1993; *Strategic Brand Management*, 2001). A four-tier cognitive hierarchy modeling the sequential construction of brand equity in long-term human memory.
artifactFull: A 4-Tier CBBE Stratification Ladder dividing brand equity into: Salience (deep category identity), Performance & Imagery (brand meaning), Judgments & Feelings (brand response), and Resonance (active, loyal psychological attachment).
trapFull: Launching high-budget emotional resonance campaigns before achieving baseline functional performance and category salience, leading to hollow recognition without commercial conversion.
